text: Let's go look! The bear is playing with the ball. The crocodile has a big mouth. The deer has pretty eyes. Look! The elephant has a long trunk. The dolphin can jump high. The giraffe's neck is long. The gorilla is beating its chest. The hippo is yawning. The kangaroo has a baby in its pocket. The lion is roaring! The monkey is hanging from the tree. The ostrich can run very fast. The panda likes bamboo. Look! The peacock is spreading its feathers. The penguin is waddling on the ice. The snake is slithering up a tree. The tiger is eating meat. The zebra has many stripes. Review!
